title: Heat Diffusion
description: Approximate two-dimensional heat diffusion, track thermal energy, and connect time-step choice with numerical stability.

zh-Hant.title: 熱擴散模擬
zh-Hant.description: 近似二維熱擴散、追蹤熱能變化，並連結時間步長選擇與數值穩定性。

artifacts.label: Heat Diffusion Snapshots
artifacts.alt: Sequence of heat maps showing a concentrated hot region spreading and cooling over simulation steps
artifacts.caption: Snapshots turn the finite-difference update into a visible process: the peak falls while heat spreads across neighboring cells.

zh-Hant.label: 熱擴散快照
zh-Hant.alt: 一系列熱圖，顯示集中的高溫區域隨模擬步驟擴散並降溫
zh-Hant.caption: 快照將有限差分更新轉為可見過程：峰值下降，同時熱量向相鄰網格擴散。

artifacts.label: Temperature Surface
artifacts.alt: Three-dimensional surface plot of the simulated temperature field at a selected time step
artifacts.caption: The surface view emphasizes the height and spatial width of the temperature peak after diffusion.

zh-Hant.label: 溫度曲面
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示所選時間步之模擬溫度場的三維曲面圖
zh-Hant.caption: 曲面視圖凸顯擴散後溫度峰值的高度與空間寬度。

artifacts.label: Thermal Energy Decay
artifacts.alt: Line chart showing normalized thermal energy and peak temperature over simulation steps
artifacts.caption: Energy and peak-temperature histories summarize how the field changes between stored snapshots.

zh-Hant.label: 熱能衰減
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示正規化熱能與峰值溫度隨模擬步驟變化的折線圖
zh-Hant.caption: 熱能與峰值溫度的歷程，概括了各儲存快照之間的溫度場變化。

artifacts.label: Numerical Stability Comparison
artifacts.alt: Comparison of stable and unstable heat-diffusion runs using different time-step ratios
artifacts.caption: Stable settings diffuse smoothly, while an excessive explicit time step produces oscillation or rapid numerical growth.

zh-Hant.label: 數值穩定性比較
zh-Hant.alt: 比較採用不同時間步長比率之穩定與不穩定熱擴散模擬的圖表
zh-Hant.caption: 穩定設定會平順擴散；過大的顯式時間步長則會造成振盪或快速數值增長。

sections.title: Code Case Overview
sections.summary: Connect a physical diffusion process with its discrete approximation and diagnostic metrics.

zh-Hant.title: 程式碼案例概覽
zh-Hant.summary: 串連物理擴散過程、離散近似方法與診斷指標。

blocks.title: Turn the heat equation into an inspectable simulation
paragraphs: This code case places a localized hot region on a two-dimensional grid and advances the heat equation with an explicit finite-difference update.
Plots and metrics show both the physical story of spreading heat and the numerical story of choosing a stable time step.

zh-Hant.title: 將熱方程轉為可檢視的模擬
paragraphs: 此程式碼案例在二維網格上放置局部高溫區域，並使用顯式有限差分更新推進熱方程。
圖表與指標同時呈現熱量擴散的物理故事，以及選擇穩定時間步長的數值故事。

items.detail: Maximum grid temperature at the initial step

zh-Hant.label: 初始峰值溫度
zh-Hant.detail: 初始步驟中的網格最高溫度

items.detail: Maximum grid temperature at the final step

zh-Hant.label: 最終峰值溫度

zh-Hant.detail: 峰值首次降至初始值一半的步驟

zh-Hant.detail: 最終熱能占初始值的百分比

items.detail: Dimensionless ratio controlling the explicit update

zh-Hant.detail: 控制顯式更新的無因次比率

blocks.title: A numerical model has two kinds of questions
blocks.content: Ask whether the result represents diffusion correctly and whether the discrete update is mathematically stable. A visually smooth plot alone does not answer both.

zh-Hant.title: 數值模型需要回答兩類問題
zh-Hant.content: 既要判斷結果是否正確呈現擴散，也要判斷離散更新在數學上是否穩定；僅靠外觀平滑的圖表無法同時回答兩者。

sections.title: Build the Finite-difference Model
sections.summary: Translate neighboring-grid temperature differences into an explicit update rule.

zh-Hant.title: 建立有限差分模型
zh-Hant.summary: 將相鄰網格的溫度差轉換為顯式更新規則。

items.title: Initialize the field
items.content: Place a localized heat peak on the grid and define the boundary behavior.

zh-Hant.title: 初始化溫度場
zh-Hant.content: 在網格上放置局部熱峰，並定義邊界行為。

items.title: Estimate spatial curvature
items.content: Use neighboring cells to approximate the two-dimensional Laplacian at each interior point.

zh-Hant.title: 估計空間曲率
zh-Hant.content: 利用相鄰網格近似每個內部點的二維拉普拉斯算子。

items.title: Advance and record
items.content: Apply the explicit update, then store selected fields and diagnostic summaries.

zh-Hant.title: 推進並記錄
zh-Hant.content: 套用顯式更新，再儲存選定的溫度場與診斷摘要。

sections.title: Read the Temperature Field
sections.summary: Use surface and snapshot views to interpret how peak height and spatial spread evolve.

zh-Hant.title: 解讀溫度場
zh-Hant.summary: 利用曲面與快照解讀峰值高度及空間擴散如何演變。

blocks.title: Cooling and spreading happen together
paragraphs: The maximum temperature decreases because energy moves away from the initially concentrated region.
At the same time, a broader area becomes warmer, so peak temperature alone cannot describe the full field.

zh-Hant.title: 降溫與擴散同時發生
paragraphs: 最高溫度會下降，因為能量從初始集中的區域向外移動。
同時，更廣的區域會升溫，因此僅看峰值溫度無法描述完整溫度場。

blocks.title: Keep the color scale consistent
blocks.content: Snapshot comparisons are easiest to interpret when every heat map uses the same temperature limits.

zh-Hant.title: 保持一致的色彩範圍
zh-Hant.content: 每張熱圖使用相同的溫度上下限時，快照之間最容易正確比較。

sections.title: Track Cooling and Energy
sections.summary: Read continuous diagnostic histories and compare the selected published snapshots.

zh-Hant.title: 追蹤冷卻與熱能
zh-Hant.summary: 解讀連續診斷歷程，並比較選定發布的模擬快照。

blocks.title: Published simulation snapshots
blocks.description: Selected steps summarize peak temperature and retained energy without loading every simulated grid.

zh-Hant.title: 已發布的模擬快照
zh-Hant.description: 選定步驟概括峰值溫度與保留熱能，不必載入每一個模擬網格。

blocks.title: Boundary conditions shape the energy curve
blocks.content: Energy may be conserved or leave the domain depending on the configured boundaries. Interpret decay only after identifying that assumption.

zh-Hant.title: 邊界條件會塑造熱能曲線
zh-Hant.content: 熱能可能守恆，也可能依邊界設定離開計算域；辨識該假設後，才能正確解讀衰減。

sections.title: Test Numerical Stability
sections.summary: Compare explicit updates and identify when a time step violates the stability requirement.

zh-Hant.title: 測試數值穩定性
zh-Hant.summary: 比較顯式更新，並辨識時間步長何時違反穩定條件。

blocks.title: Stability tests
blocks.description: Each test changes the explicit update ratio while keeping the physical setup comparable.

zh-Hant.title: 穩定性測試
zh-Hant.description: 每項測試會改變顯式更新比率，同時維持可比較的物理設定。

blocks.title: An unstable run is not a faster approximation
blocks.content: Once the stability limit is exceeded, oscillation and growth are numerical artifacts rather than accelerated physical diffusion.

zh-Hant.title: 不穩定模擬不是更快的近似
zh-Hant.content: 超過穩定極限後，振盪與增長屬於數值假象，而不是加速的物理擴散。

sections.title: Trace the Source Code
sections.summary: Connect the experiment definition, numerical solver, diagnostics, and plot export pipeline.

zh-Hant.title: 追蹤原始程式碼
zh-Hant.summary: 串連實驗定義、數值求解器、診斷計算與圖表匯出流程。

blocks.title: Keep numerical updates isolated and testable
paragraphs: The main function defines the grid and publication workflow, while the solver advances temperature and returns diagnostics.
The plotting helper turns those returned values into documented repository views without modifying the numerical result.

zh-Hant.title: 讓數值更新保持獨立且可測試
paragraphs: 主函式定義網格與發布流程，求解器則推進溫度並回傳診斷結果。
繪圖輔助函式將回傳值轉為案例庫文件視圖，而不修改數值結果。
